label: Enumerating k-feasible cuts
subgoals: Start each primary input with its trivial cut
Merge every cut of one fanin with every cut of the other
Keep unions with at most k leaves and add the trivial cut

label: Depth-optimal labels
subgoals: Take 1 plus the largest leaf label for each non-trivial cut
Keep the minimum over cuts in topological order

label: Covering and what depth saves
subgoals: Trace the label-achieving cut back from each output
Subtract the label from the gate level to get the saving
Bound the cut set with priority cuts for scalability
